game.title: Sabi Quiz
game.howto.1: Ten questions, one at a time. Tap an answer plate, or press A to D (or 1 to 4). Beat the clock before it runs out.
game.howto.2: The faster you answer right, the more points you get. A wrong answer or time up scores nothing.
game.howto.3: Answer right again and again to build a streak: x2 at 3 in a row, x3 at 5, x5 at 8. A miss breaks it.
game.howto.4: Three lifelines, each once a round: 50/50 removes two wrong answers, Skip swaps the question, Ask your padi shows a crowd vote (a padi can be wrong!). Keys: F, S, H, or L for the next one.
game.howto.5: Quiz Duel: race a CPU contestant. Both of you answer the same question, and the faster right answer scores more. Daily Challenge: the same ten questions for everybody today, one scored try a day. P or Esc pauses.
